capabilities.sentence: Read your instruments: position, heading, depth, wind.

settings.label: Closest approach (CPA)
settings.desc: Alarm when a vessel will pass closer than this.

settings.label: Time to closest approach (TCPA)
settings.desc: Alarm only when that pass is this soon or sooner.

settings.label: Collision alarm
settings.desc: Sound the alarm and colour the vessel red. Off silences both.

settings.label: Course vectors
settings.desc: How far ahead of each vessel its course line is drawn.

settings.label: Hide targets under
settings.desc: Leave out vessels slower than this. Zero shows every one, moored ships included.

capabilities.sentence: Read your instruments: position, heading, depth, wind.

settings.label: Upwind angle
settings.desc: How close to the true wind the boat holds on the beat. Half the angle you tack through.

settings.label: Downwind angle
settings.desc: How deep the boat runs, measured off the true wind the same way. At 180 the two lines lie on top of each other.

lists.footer: A Signal K server sends the whole boat as one stream of updates on port 8375. Give its address, and everything switched on here feeds the same chart.

item_fields.label: Name
item_fields.desc: What you call this server. Leave it empty to show the address.

item_fields.label: Address
item_fields.desc: The name or IP address of the Signal K server.

item_fields.label: Port
item_fields.desc: Most Signal K servers stream on port 8375. Port 3000 is the web page, not the stream.

item_fields.label: WebSocket
item_fields.desc: Read the WebSocket stream instead of the plain one. The reference server serves it on port 3000.

item_fields.label: On
item_fields.desc: Off closes the stream and stops reconnecting.
